welcome.title: Welcome aboard
welcome.content: A quick demo tour of Lighthouse, an app that enables you to manage inventories of your items, rooms, and locations.

homes.title: More than one home
homes.content: Lighthouse can keep track of several places at once – a house, an apartment, a desk at work. Tap the home icon to see yours.

homesList.title: Switching homes
homesList.content: You're in {{current}} – the one with the 🏠 beside it. Tap {{other}} to switch everything, items and rooms and locations, across to that home.

homesSwitched.title: Switched over
homesSwitched.content: {{name}} has the 🏠 now. Every item, room and location from here on belongs to it.

items.title: Items
items.content: Everything you own lives here: One flat list of every item, across every room.

itemsList.title: Everything, in one place
itemsList.content: Each entry shows what the thing is, and underneath it, the location and room where you'll find it.

itemPicture.title: Add a picture
itemPicture.content: Items, rooms and locations can all carry a photo. Tap the icon beside {{name}} to give it one.

pictureModal.title: Its picture
pictureModal.content: Take a photo or pick one from your library. Rooms and locations work the same way.

itemsFilter.title: Search and filter
itemsFilter.content: Tap the sort and filter icon to narrow this list down.

filterModal.title: Search and filter
filterModal.content: Looking for one thing in particular? Search by name, or narrow the list down to certain rooms and locations.

itemsAdd.title: Add an item
itemsAdd.content: Tap the plus to put something new into this home.

addModal.title: Add an item
addModal.content: Add something new here. You can choose the room and location for it, or create them if they don't exist yet.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.content: Items are organised by room, and then by a location inside that room. Let's look at the rooms.

roomsList.title: Your rooms
roomsList.content: Each room shows how many locations and items it holds. Tap {{name}} to see inside it.

locationsList.title: Locations
locationsList.content: Locations are the specific spots within a room – a drawer, a shelf, a box. Tap {{name}} to see what's sitting in it.

locationItems.title: What's in there
locationItems.content: Just the items in {{name}}, rather than the whole home. Every location opens like this.

backup.title: Backup
backup.content: Lighthouse keeps everything on your device and nowhere else. Save it all to a file here, and bring it back on another one.

finish.title: That's the tour
finish.content: You'll be back to the home page now. Enjoy Lighthouse!
